test_title: PYST 31: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the ANTONYM of the word affable to fill in the blank.**

We were entering the ________ territory.
solution: The correct answer is: **Hostile**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Affable **means friendly and easy to talk to. (मिलनसार और बात करने में आसान) • **Example**: *The host was affable, making everyone feel welcome at the party.* • Marked option **hostile** means unfriendly or aggressive. (अमित्र या आक्रामक) • **Example**: *The dog became hostile towards strangers, barking loudly and showing its teeth.* • In the given sentence, we need a word that shows the territory as unwelcoming or unfriendly, hence '**hostile**' is the correct option. Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Aggravate **means to make a situation worse or more serious. (किसी स्थिति को बदतर या अधिक गंभीर बनाना) • **Sardonic **means mocking or cynical. (मज़ाक उड़ाना या निंदक) • **Amicable **means friendly or peaceful. (मैत्रीपूर्ण या शांतिपूर्ण) 41:T4f7, The correct answer is: **B, D, C, A**
